scope: Existing frozen 40 AISHELL read-speech development files, no new independent test set and no physical microphone
augmentation: Append 10 seconds of exact silence; preserve all original frames, use same augmented input for baseline
endpoint: Unchanged EnergyEndpoint defaults from frozen endpointing-protocol.json, chunk size4096, native16000Hz
asr: Same local faster-whisper-small revision/quantization; GPU chosen at launch, batch1, beam5, zh, no conditioning, simplified-Chinese initial prompt
comparison: Alternate full augmented clip and automatically stopped clip order per sample; retain all outputs; no_speech maps to full reference deletion
limits: No human speech-boundary labels. Clip duration difference is not speech endpoint error. CER is an indirect information-loss check; synthetic appended silence and read speech cannot represent real noisy conversations. Do not tune threshold on these outputs.
